g.text: Declared focus positions and real artwork. Schematic spacing; not a native screenshot. Hover a node for its full purpose.

g.title: SBK_nat_civil_register | A Register under Present Authority | Contemporary first-entry scene chooses a registry priority without replaying historical transfers.
SBK_nat_urgent_repairs | The First Work Order | Choose urgent utility maintenance or a broader case hearing.
SBK_nat_resident_casework | Hear the Resident First | Resident-first standing procedure: stability and slower discretionary production.
SBK_nat_emergency_orders | An Emergency Order Desk | Alternative emergency procedure: repair speed with public and consumer burdens.
SBK_nat_property_claims | The Property File | Unlock the one-time property case with two materially different settlements.
SBK_nat_service_docket | The Utility Work Docket | Unlock the utility case, including real support-stock expenditure.
SBK_nat_stores_reconciliation | Reconcile the Stores | Unlock a stock-accountability case; no duplication of inherited transfers.
SBK_nat_civil_receipts | Receipts for Civil Work | Unlock paid receipt verification that changes the docket resolution cost.
SBK_nat_bounded_advisers | An Adviser with a Written Remit | Choose to seek limited technical advice or keep the work entirely domestic.
SBK_nat_records_recovery | The Displaced Records | Choose witness-based record recovery or protected interim records.
SBK_nat_hearing_calendar | A Day for Security Questions | Unlock the security-remit civil case.
SBK_nat_local_witnesses | Local Witnesses | Unlock witness-led property and archive resolutions with a different staffing cost.
SBK_nat_two_signatures | Two Cases, Two Responsible Officers | Raise simultaneous civil cases from one to two; no unlimited case slots.
SBK_nat_provisional_charter | A Provisional Civil Procedure | Unlock a costed standing civil charter tailored to subject or independent status.
SBK_nat_review_authority | Review the Authority to Order | Security and administrative review chooses published limits or rapid instruction handling.
SBK_nat_published_orders | Publish the Order | Replace the initial procedure with public-order scrutiny.
SBK_nat_delegated_command | A Defined Delegation | Alternative delegated local-command policy with continuing legitimacy cost.
SBK_nat_core_and_resident | Residents beyond the Register | Unlock a resident-access case useful on non-core treaty footprints.
SBK_nat_appeal_routes | The Route of Appeal | Allow each closed case one costed reopening, replacing rather than stacking its prior benefit.
SBK_nat_limited_remit | The Limit of a Guarantee | Choose external technical consent or an explicitly domestic continuation.
SBK_nat_service_inspector | The Workshop Inspector | Unlock the limited adviser request and a useful domestic inspection after refusal.
SBK_nat_displaced_archives | An Archive Case | Unlock the archive case, including the earned witness alternative.
SBK_nat_security_review | Review the Local Security Remit | Unlock the enhanced security-case resolution; no phantom demobilisation reward.
SBK_nat_measured_training | Instruction within the Existing Service | Unlock a paid service-instruction interval using existing support equipment.
SBK_nat_maintenance_budget | An Account for Maintenance | Unlock a standing maintenance policy with a real annual fiscal commitment when enabled.
SBK_nat_public_receipts | Read the Unresolved Claims | Unresolved-claims scene chooses protected interim access or paid inquiry.
SBK_nat_standing_work_orders | A Work Order after the Hearing | Extend future utility and access case settlements only after actual resolution.
SBK_nat_civil_continuity | Continuity without a New Settlement | Unlock an interruption review that closes open cases without a completion award.
SBK_nat_renewal_of_authority | Renew the Civil Authority | 2006-or-later budget-authority scene chooses public review or a professional case bench.
SBK_nat_elected_hearing | A Public Hearing Bench | Terminal participatory case procedure preserves existing political identities.
SBK_nat_professional_bench | A Professional Case Bench | Alternative terminal technical procedure with political and consumer burdens.
SBK_nat_obsolete_claims | Close an Obsolete Claim | Unlock costless closure of a currently open case without granting its outcome.
SBK_nat_external_orders | Two Conflicting Instructions | Choose a narrow local remit or disclosed external coordination with useful subject and refusal outcomes.
SBK_nat_accountable_services | Account for the Standing Service | Unlock a removable civil reliability policy with an exact recorded fiscal commitment.
SBK_nat_relief_appeal | An Appeal beside Reconstruction | Unlock a local relief review contingent on the owning response or a peaceful substitute.
SBK_nat_resident_consent | The Resident May Decline | Unlock the low-stock interim settlement for utility and access cases.
SBK_nat_narrow_security_remit | A Narrow Security Remit | Unlock a narrowly bounded oversight policy independent of foreign adviser consent.
SBK_nat_municipal_workshops | The Municipal Maintenance Round | Unlock a domestic stock-backed workshop interval available under every alignment.
SBK_nat_common_archive | Keep a Common Civil Archive | Unlock a one-time archive verification that reduces future case fees.
SBK_nat_public_interest_test | State the Public Interest | Unlock voluntary removal of this campaign's standing policies and exact fiscal commitments.
SBK_nat_final_docket | The Final Docket | 2013-or-later assessment selects accountable continuity or a narrower interim administration.
SBK_nat_standing_civil_arrangement | A Standing Civil Arrangement | Unlock distinct independent, supervised and domestic-after-refusal conclusions.
